description: Zones payantes et bleue du stationnement Naolib de la ville de Nantes is a dataset listed in Open Data Nantes Métropole, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Nantes. Zones de stationnement de la ville de Nantes Pour en savoir plus, vous pouvez consulter le site de metropole.nantes.fr. Coverage: Nantes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are stationnement, auto, Naolib. The portal shows 205 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte-LO (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-nantesmetropole-fr-portal.
